verdict.rationale: Angular ships an official CLI, installed with `npm install -g @angular/cli`. Its `new` command creates a workspace and its `serve` command builds and serves the app with rebuilds on file changes. The GitHub README advertises getting started in 5 minutes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scaffolding and running a new project actually takes only a few minutes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and run a new project in just a few minutes using an official CLI or starter

citations.quote: Install the Angular CLI globally: npm install -g @angular/cli
Builds and serves your application, rebuilding on file changes.
